skill.name: new-jersey-business-registry-lookup-and-name-checker
skill.description: Look up New Jersey registered businesses by name, keyword or entity ID, and check whether a candidate business name is available for a new filing. Returns entity ID, entity type, city and incorporation date. Output fields: businessName, entityTypeAbbr, entityTypeFull, city, incorporatedDate and more, as JSON rows. Use it for requests like "New Jersey business entity search", "business name availability check", or a CSV/JSON export of public NJ business registry data.
skill.summary: Search public New Jersey business records and check candidate names through an Apify Actor.
skill.author: bolvein-firex

security_audit.summary: All 64 static findings are false positives in context: documented Apify requests, explicit input reads, environment configuration, and formatting. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, destructive behavior, or arbitrary command execution in the supplied files. The remote Actor implementation was not supplied, so its behavior and data handling remain outside this review.

content.user_title: Search New Jersey Businesses and Check Names
content.value_statement: Manual registry searches make business research repetitive. This skill provides documented Apify workflows for public New Jersey business searches and candidate name checks.
actual_capabilities: Submit business name prefix searches or keyword searches through the documented Apify Actor.
Prepare exact entity lookups using ten-digit New Jersey entity IDs.
Configure searches by principal, registered agent, or associated name, with optional name and city inputs.
Request candidate name availability checks using base names without company designators.
Request free document indexes for specified entity IDs through the documented documents mode.
Configure entity type and city filters, limit results to 1-500 records, and retrieve JSON datasets using Node or documented API calls.
limitations: Execution requires an Apify account and APIFY_TOKEN; Actor usage is billed through that account.
The remote Actor source is not included, and live results were not verified during this review.
Only public registry information and free document indexes are in scope; private records and paid document contents are excluded.
Results are capped at 500 records, and name availability does not reserve a name or guarantee filing approval.

use_cases.title: Screen Candidate Business Names
use_cases.description: Check proposed base names before preparing a New Jersey business filing, then confirm availability through official state channels.

use_cases.title: Research Public Entity Records
use_cases.description: Look up known entity IDs and request free document indexes to support a public-records review.

use_cases.title: Build a Focused Business Dataset
use_cases.description: Search industry keywords and apply city or entity type filters to collect a bounded dataset for analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Business
prompt_templates.prompt: Search New Jersey business names beginning with [business name]. Limit results to 25 and summarize entity IDs, types, cities, and incorporation dates. Confirm Apify costs before running.

prompt_templates.title: Check Candidate Names
prompt_templates.prompt: Check availability for [candidate base names] in New Jersey. Remove company designators and flag names with fewer than four effective characters. Confirm costs before running and distinguish availability from reservation.

prompt_templates.title: Filter an Industry Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search New Jersey businesses using [keyword phrases]. Filter to [city] and [entity types], with at most 100 results. Confirm costs before running and explain the keyword matching rules.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: combine search inputs and filters.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Linked Records Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a registered-agent search for [agent name] in [city], capped at 25 results. Confirm costs before execution. Then request free document indexes for selected entity IDs and summarize only returned evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate linked-name and document-index searches.

best_practices: Start with 25 results and confirm current Actor pricing before increasing the limit.
Send only intended public search inputs, keep APIFY_TOKEN secret, and verify the Actor identity before execution.
Confirm important records and filing decisions with official New Jersey sources.
anti_patterns: Submitting cookies, sessions, private account data, or unrelated local files as search input.
Treating name availability as a reservation, trademark clearance, or guaranteed filing approval.
Using registry results for spam, harassment, unlawful discrimination, or collection beyond applicable terms.

faq.question: Does this search every state?
faq.answer: No. The documented Actor searches public New Jersey business registry information.

faq.question: What do I need to run it?
faq.answer: You need an Apify account and APIFY_TOKEN. The supplied runner requires Node 18 or later; documented alternatives use curl and jq.

faq.question: Is the service free?
faq.answer: The source records are public, but Apify bills Actor usage to your account. Check the current Actor pricing before running.

faq.question: Can I search by agent or officer?
faq.answer: The input schema supports linked-name searches for principals, registered agents, and associated names. Available filters depend on the selected search type.

faq.question: Does an available name guarantee approval?
faq.answer: No. Availability does not reserve a name or establish trademark clearance. Confirm filing requirements with the state.

faq.question: Can it download paid filing documents?
faq.answer: No. The documented scope includes free document indexes, not private records or paid document contents.
